evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.991 Torr at 100 sccm Ar near the end of the ramp.
Growth pressure was 3.014 Torr, then rose monotonically through 3.109 and 3.196 Torr to 3.276 Torr at 3000 s.
Temperature and Ar remain near their setpoints at 749.4 °C and 99.8 sccm, while pressure has risen about 10% above its earlier baseline; heater power is 45.3%.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed, so oxygen telemetry cannot distinguish air ingress from other pressure-rise causes.
